fusions.name: Lazy Current
fusions.desc: Rolls a heavy swell into the first enemy it meets, dealing 10 damage, knocking it back 2 tiles and with a 60% chance leaving it [Stalled] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow Swell
fusions.desc: A swell that rolls out and deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Drifting Recovery
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Banked Calm
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you gain a shield worth 15% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
